Name: Secret Garden Springs (PIF)
Author: Sharogg
Description:
Add a foresty retreat area to your farmhouse with [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/20537]PIF - Personal Rooms[/url]. It works like the backyard, meaning you can grow crops, plant trees, keep animals and decorate. It features a hot spring to swim and refresh your energy. Does not increase size with farmhouse upgrades.

You need to buy one of the doors from PIF or a decorational door to access it.

[b]Features[/b]
[list]
[*]Grass tiles tillable
[*]Buildable location
[*]No weeds or dirt decay
[*]Some berry bushes
[*]Hang the painting of the season on the cliffs
[*]Hot springs!
[*]Optional greenhouse function
[/list][b]
Compatibility[/b]
Recolours: This mod uses several outdoor tilesheets, so recolour compatibility depends on those (alvadea's tilesheet decorations are optional for that reason). Otherwise should be compatible with everything that PIF is compatible with.

[b]Installation[/b]
Unzip the mod and paste it into Stardew Valley's Mods folder. Requires SMAPI,
Content Patcher and PIF. 1.6. is required.
